# Consensus-layer Call 133

[prev: call 132](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1010)

Meeting Date/Time: [Thursday 2024/5/2 at 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/may-2-2024/2pm)
Meeting Duration: 1.5 hours
[stream](https://youtube.com/live/LazOhUu1Tew?feature=share)

0. Update on [confirmation rule research](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1031#issuecomment-2084847376)
1. Electra
    * EIP-7547 and Electra CFI
    * `v1.5.0-alpha.1` specs release: bugfixes for pectra, peerdas test vectors
    * devnet-0 progress/status
3. Research, spec, etc
    * EIP-7684 presentation
    * Anything for PeerDAS?
4. Open discussion/Closing remarks
    * Next ACDC is cancelled. Next ACDC will be **30 May 2pm UTC**

comments.body:
I would like to present our latest research on defining a confirmation rule for Ethereum.
If possible, it would be great if my presentation could be scheduled at the beginning of the call as, due to timezones, it will be quite late for me.
[Here](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.00549) is the paper describing the protocol.
And here is the related PR: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3339

### [EIP7547](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7547) Inclusion lists

If inclusion list issues with EIP3074 can’t be resolved for Electra (as per last ACDC: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=srOu8TqFYYM&t=3634s), should inclusion lists be removed from CFI for Pectra (Meta [EIP7600](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7600))?

I'd like to take 5-10m to present [EIP-7684](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-7684.md): mitigating the potential deposit frontrunning vulnerability on Ethereum protocol level. 
EDIT: Added a short[ motivation doc.](https://hackmd.io/@vsh/SJXXLZZzA)
